evidence.title: 10-Year Treasury Inflation-Indexed Security, Constant Maturity
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was -0.04 percentage points; it resolved to 'within recent range'.

evidence.title: Real Interest Rates Around the World 1946 - 2023
evidence.summary: Provides a definition of real interest rates as the difference between the Central Bank Policy Rate and the inflation rate, which is fundamental to understanding the United States 10-year real Treasury yield. It also offers historical context for real interest rates globally up to 2023.

evidence.title: The US economy is so strong that there might not be any rate cuts in 2024
evidence.summary: Discusses the Federal Reserve's stance on interest rate cuts as of March 1, 2024, indicating that expectations for cuts were being pushed back due to a strong economy and persistent inflation. This directly impacts the nominal Treasury yield component of the real yield.

evidence.title: "Quantitative Tightening" or "Operation Twist" is coming up. What are the implications for bonds?
evidence.summary: Explains the potential impact of Quantitative Tightening (QT) tapering and a reverse 'Operation Twist' on the yield curve, particularly for long-term US Treasuries. This directly influences the nominal 10-year Treasury yield.

evidence.title: Answered: 1. Graph investors' long-term expected inflation rate since 2003 by subtracting from the 10-year U.S. Treasury bond yield (FRED code: GS10) the yield on 10-year… | bartleby
evidence.summary: Defines how to calculate market-based inflation expectations using the difference between the 10-year U.S. Treasury bond yield and the 10-year Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) yield. This is crucial for understanding the inflation component of the real yield.

evidence.title: Footnotes & Flashbacks: State of Yields 3-10-24
evidence.summary: Reports on the struggles of US Treasury bonds in 2024 due to good economic news and mixed inflation numbers, leading to an 'adverse UST shift YTD 3-8-24'. This directly impacts the nominal 10-year Treasury yield.

evidence.title: PolitiFact | Is inflation down to 2%, as Joe Biden said? It depends on your metric
evidence.summary: Discusses different inflation metrics and the Federal Reserve's target of 2% inflation before considering interest rate cuts. This directly relates to the inflation component of the real yield and the Fed's monetary policy decisions.

evidence.title: Real Rate of Return Calculator (Inflation adjusted) - fide2020.eu
evidence.summary: Provides a general understanding of how real rates of return are calculated by adjusting for inflation, which is directly applicable to the concept of real Treasury yields.

evidence.title: Jim Bianco: FED Cuts, May, June or Bust?
evidence.summary: Reflects market expectations and expert opinions on the timing of potential Fed rate cuts, which directly influences the nominal 10-year Treasury yield and, consequently, the real yield.
